neighbours.label: a word-initial single-letter ' c' piece that starts a rare word split letter by letter (c|enser, c|asket)
fire: Smoke from the silver censer drifted across the chapel.
The monks carried a heavy censer through the cloister.
Incense burned in a brass censer beside the altar.
The altar boy swung the censer three times toward the crowd.
A battered censer was found among the ruins of the abbey.
She polished the old censer until it shone.
Each priest took a censer and filled it with coals.
The museum displays a medieval censer made of bronze.
quiet: Smoke from the silver lamp drifted across the chapel.
The monks carried a heavy cross through the cloister.
Incense burned in a brass bowl beside the altar.
The altar boy rang the bell three times toward the crowd.
A battered chalice was found among the ruins of the abbey.
She polished the old candlestick until it shone.
Each priest took a candle and lit it from the fire.
The museum displays a medieval sword made of bronze.

notes: card: ' c' x8, ' C', '-c', Cyrillic ' к'/' ц' at the start of rare split words. Probe: censer 0.58, casket 0.07, cauldron 0.07. Expect mixed results depending on tokenization.
